info.title: UniGate API
info.description: Vehicle hiring & management platform. Money is a decimal string; timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC; every response uses the same envelope.

get.summary: Readiness — dependency reachability as booleans only

post.summary: Start registration; sends a REGISTRATION OTP to the phone
Password login (WEB → cookies, mobile → tokens in body)
Rotate the refresh token (cookie ug_rt or body). Replay revokes the whole family.
Revoke every session of the caller

get.summary: Echo the current session (cheap liveness check for the web app)

post.summary: Send an OTP (REGISTRATION, LOGIN, PHONE_VERIFICATION, PASSWORD_RESET)
Verify an OTP; REGISTRATION / LOGIN open a session
Send a SENSITIVE_ACTION code to the caller’s verified phone
Exchange the code for a single-use 5-minute step-up token
Always 200; sends a reset link/code only if the identifier exists
Consume a reset token once; revokes every session
Change password; revokes other sessions and re-issues this session’s access token
